title: The Cotton Club and its beautiful girls
summary: She visited but never worked the gangster-owned Cotton Club, which featured Lena Horne and Evelyn Shepherd.

blocks.x: Now, did you -- you must have gone to the Cotton Club.

Cotton Club was nice. They had beautiful -- now, that's where they had some beautiful girls, at the Cotton Club. Those gangsters in there had nothing else but those beautiful girls, you know, to work there. It was Evelyn Shepherd, Evelyn and her sister -- Evelyn Shepherd, Lena Horne --
Lena Horne -- now, she used to -- when she came out of high school, Lena Horne, I found a picture of her conducting the Noble Sissle Orchestra.
Right? She was called Leona Horne.
You could have a million dollars, you know, if your background wasn't reared right, you know --
